reason: Letter A is honest about the 5-week absence and the 2-day notice, and it turns them into a point in Tomás's favor: he found cover and came back on the day he promised. Letter B leaves out the absence and says he arranged cover before he came to his manager, which the facts don't support. B also makes stronger claims, but A still persuades without bending the facts, though it leaves out Tomás's last name.
